wiki.title: Harold M. Love Jr.
wiki.extract: Harold Moses Love Jr. is an American politician. A member of the Democratic Party, he represents the 58th District in the Tennessee House of Representatives. He is the House Democratic assistant leader and President of The National Black Caucus of State Legislators. Love's father, Harold Moses Love Sr., was a Nashville city councilman from 1962 to 1970 and a member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for the 54th District from 1968 to 1994.
